title: bheka.detection.raised.v1
description: Emitted by bheka-policy when a policy rule matches incoming telemetry and creates a detections row in PostgreSQL. Never emitted by bheka-gateway; the REST API has no create-detection endpoint (009_API_SURFACE section 8). Stream: DETECTION. Consumers: bheka-case (case linkage suggestion), bheka-notify (admin alerting), bheka-console (real-time feed).

event_id.description: UUIDv7. De-duplicate consumers on this field.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC at which bheka-policy raised the detection.

detection_id.description: UUIDv7 of the detections row created in PostgreSQL.

tenant_id.description: UUIDv7 of the tenant whose data triggered the detection.

policy_rule_id.description: UUIDv7 of the policy_rules row that matched.

subject_user_id.description: UUIDv7 of the users row for the data subject whose activity triggered the detection.

tier.description: Visibility tier of the telemetry that triggered this detection (CANON section 4).

source_event_ids.description: ClickHouse row identifiers for the matching telemetry events. Pointers only — no event content (008_DATA_MODEL section 4, tier-boundary rule).
